title: Radial Fibres

positions.as_written: Expect a longitudinal tear to be commoner because it fails the weaker direction.
Treat loss of shape under load as a radial fibre problem as well as a hoop problem.
Use the tear pattern as evidence of which fibre system failed.
Treat the two systems as two separate repair problems.
Expect a radial repair to be the harder problem, because the construct carries the hoop tension.
Protect load after a radial repair, on the ground that the construct is the tension path.
